**<sub><sub>![P1 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P1-orange?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Preserve readiness when returning an idempotent plan**

When the same candidate is committed again, this returns the record loaded by `PostgresWorkflowPlanRepository.findPlan()`, but that mapper does not hydrate `executionReadiness`. A retry after a readiness decision such as `confirmation_required` therefore returns the same plan with readiness set to `undefined`; the formal task and child-plan paths treat an absent readiness projection as no confirmation blocker and may auto-confirm it. Return the candidate's verified readiness or reload the authoritative readiness evidence before taking this idempotent branch.

**<sub><sub>![P1 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P1-orange?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Commit deferred planning audits atomically with the plan**

For a device-scoped GOWM candidate, every attempt has `persisted: false`, so this loop creates the planning root and inserts `(plan_id, attempt)` before readiness persistence and `savePlanAndSupersede()`. If a later audit write fails or the source-plan CAS rejects, those earlier transactions remain in PostgreSQL; retrying the same candidate then hits the attempt primary key and can never reach plan finalization, while a stale revision leaves an orphan formal root. The deferred audits and final plan/CAS need one transaction, or the audit inserts must be idempotent with failed commits cleaned up.
